service.description: File and SFTP transfers (brokerUri file:directory or sftp://host:port/directory with a pinned host-key-fingerprint). DrtContentTransfer writes the DeviceContent of deviceContentId and the transferFiles; DrtConfigWrite writes the transferFiles of a recipe export (moqui.device.DeviceConfigServices). Set as DeviceRequest.runServiceName; called by moqui.device.DeviceServices.run#DeviceRequest. A request whose endpoint is another protocol is an error.
